.lab/upstream/endpoints.json.scope: an object with one entry per runtime id (e_ and 24 hex digits); the keys below are the entry's

auth.meaning: base URL of the environment's Auth service

rest.meaning: base URL of the environment's REST service

storage.meaning: the shared Storage as this environment reaches it: url and tenantHost (read on the routing path)

functions.meaning: Edge Functions of the environment: url (read on the routing path) and storage, the listener {host, port, subnet} that gives them the shared Storage

realtime.meaning: the environment's own Realtime service: url and tenantHost (read on the routing path)

serviceConcurrency.meaning: the gateway's admission maximum for auth, rest and storage, as numbers (read on the routing path)

host.meaning: address of the shared PostgreSQL cluster the direct database listener forwards to

port.meaning: port of the shared PostgreSQL cluster

sessions.meaning: one entry per runtime id with a Studio session; url is where it is served

upstream.meaning: host and port of the internal listener Studio's server-side calls arrive on

.lab/upstream/write-pauses/e_*.json.scope: one object per environment paused for writes; the file's existence is the pause

auth.meaning: base URL of the management Auth realm

.secrets/upstream/runtime.json.scope: an object, read by its shape only and never printed

management.meaning: the management realm's signing secret as jwt

environments.meaning: one entry per runtime id, with the environment's signing secret as jwt
